sn35.73:1.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam nappajānāti || avusitam tena brahmacariyam ārakā so imasmā dhammavinayā ti || ||
sn35.73:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Etthāham bhante anassāsiṃ || ahañhi bhante channam phassayātanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmīti || ||
sn35.73:3.1: Taṃ kim maññasi bhikkhu || cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.73:5.1: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.73:7.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallan nu taṃ samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.73:9.1: Sotam || Ghānam || Jivhā || Kāyo || Mano nicco vā anicco vā ti || ||
sn35.73:11.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.73:13.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallan nu taṃ samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.73:15.1: Evam passam bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || manasmim pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyam nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Migajālavaggo dutiyo || ||
sn35.73:16.0: Tassa uddānaṃ || || Migajālena dve vuttā || Cattāro ca Samiddhinā || Upaseno Upavāṇo ca || Chaphassāyatanikā tayo ti || ||
